content: Amoxicillin is a semisynthetic antibiotic that is structurally related to ampicillin. It exhibits a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity, effectively targeting a wide range of gram-positive and gram-negative microorganisms. Chemically, it is identified as (2S,5R,6R)-6-[3,3-dimethyl-7-oxo-4-thia-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptane-2-carboxylic acid] trihydrate. Its molecular formula is C16H19N3O5S·3H2O, and it has a molecular weight of 419.45. Amoxicillin is available in various formulations, including capsules, tablets, chewable tablets, and powder for oral suspension, all intended for oral administration. Capsules Amoxicillin capsules are available in strengths of 250 mg or 500 mg, with the active ingredient being amoxicillin trihydrate, which is equivalent to amoxicillin anhydrous. The inactive ingredients in the capsules include black iron oxide, colloidal silicon dioxide, croscarmellose sodium, D&C Yellow No. 10, FD&C Yellow No. 6, gelatin, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, shellac, sodium lauryl sulfate, and titanium dioxide. Additionally, the 250 mg capsules contain FD&C Red No. 40, while the 500 mg capsules contain D&C Red No. 28 and FD&C Blue No. 1. Tablets Amoxicillin tablets are available in strengths of 500 mg or 875 mg, with the active ingredient being amoxicillin trihydrate, equivalent to amoxicillin anhydrous. The inactive ingredients in the tablets include colloidal silicon dioxide, crospovidone, D&C Red No. 30 aluminum lake, hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide. Chewable Tablets Chewable tablets are available in strengths of 125 mg, 200 mg, 250 mg, or 400 mg, with the active ingredient being amoxicillin trihydrate, equivalent to amoxicillin anhydrous. The inactive ingredients in the chewable tablets include aspartame, FD&C Red No. 40 aluminum lake, magnesium stearate, mannitol, and strawberry guarana flavor. The 125 mg and 250 mg chewable tablets also contain corn starch, compressible sugar, and talc, while the 200 mg and 400 mg chewable tablets contain crospovidone. Powder for Oral Suspension The powder for oral suspension, when reconstituted, provides 200 mg or 400 mg of amoxicillin per 5 mL, with the active ingredient being amoxicillin trihydrate. Each 5 mL of the reconstituted suspension contains 0.24 mEq (5.59 mg) of sodium. The suspension is flavored with a fruity profile and contains inactive ingredients such as colloidal silicon dioxide, FD&C Yellow No. 6, strawberry guarana flavor, tutti frutti flavor, sodium benzoate, sodium citrate, sucrose, and xanthan gum.
